name: Slenderman - From Dusk Till Dawn
author: Afergan11_Studios
description:
Slenderman - From Dusk Till Dawn is a homage to the classic horror game "Slenderman - The 8 notes".

This is my final project as part of my Game Development course.

--------------------------------------------------------------------

Explore the forest to collect all 8 notes.
Don't waste your time or else the Slenderman
will catch you!

*Recommendations*
1. Play in a dark room.
2. Wear headphones.
3. If you have heart problems, ignore 1 & 2 :)
